subject.title: typedocs-only PR to help others avoid kubernetes OOM-kills

question: Should the shared Kubernetes manifest ship a fixed `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536` heap cap by default, or should this remain optional operator guidance?
rationale: The change may be a useful mitigation, but it changes inherited deployment behavior for everyone applying the sample manifest and requires maintainer intent beyond a mechanical docs fix.

options.title: Ship fixed cap after correction and proof
options.body: Correct the Node/cgroup explanation, add redacted Kubernetes proof, and keep the manifest default as an intentional shared deployment choice.

options.title: Make it optional guidance
options.body: Keep the docs note but remove the fixed env var from the base manifest so operators opt in through their overlay.

options.title: Pause until stronger evidence
options.body: Leave the PR open or ask for a narrower repro if maintainers do not want to bless a default based on one local report.

recommendation.title: Ship fixed cap after correction and proof
recommendation.body: Correct the Node/cgroup explanation, add redacted Kubernetes proof, and keep the manifest default as an intentional shared deployment choice.
